A study routine that checks understanding

  1. Read one guide chapter and explain its diagram in your own words.
  2. Trace the worked example. Change an input and predict the result.
  3. Answer the chapter check question, then attempt the separate practice sheet.
  4. Compare with the worked answers and record why your approach differed.
  5. Use the PowerPoint to revise, then return to the online lessons and practice exams for more work.

Study in short sessions across several days. These resources support revision alongside your module outline and lecturer guidance. SQL Server, WPF and Docker examples require the stated local environment.
